diagram_previews.alt: Floor and wall meeting at the corner O, with a dashed green quarter circle of radius 1/2 centred at O. A blue ladder runs from X(x,0) on the floor to Y(0,y) on the wall; its midpoint M is a red dot on the quarter circle, joined to O by a red dashed segment labelled 1/2. Grey dots on the quarter circle mark the midpoints of other positions of the ladder.
